import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style for better aesthetics
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(50, 600), # Adjust min/max size for better visual distinction
    palette='viridis', # Perceptually uniform colormap for sequential data
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolor='w', # Add white edges to points for better separation
    linewidth=0.5
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration, Quality, Stress, and Physical Activity', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Customize ticks for better readability
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Place the legend outside the plot area to prevent overlap
plt.legend(title='Stress Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0,
           frameon=True, shadow=True, fancybox=True)

# Ensure all elements fit within the figure area
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.95, 1]) # Adjust rect to make space for the legend

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
